feed.title: The Dry Standard
feed.subtitle: Editorial reviews of dealcoholized and non-alcoholic drinks at 0.5% ABV or less, with a hard line between alcohol-removed products and zero-proof formulations.

entry.title: 90+ Cellars Lot 229 Sparkling Rosé
entry.summary: Lot 229 is Grenache from the South of France, fermented as sparkling wine, then dealcoholized by reverse osmosis to under 0.5% ABV.

entry.title: 90+ Cellars Lot 230 Non-Alcoholic Sparkling Brut
entry.summary: 90+ Cellars Lot 230 is a South West French dealcoholized sparkling brut from Souvignier Gris: under 0.5% ABV, 25 calories, around $13 a bottle.

entry.title: Alcohol-Free Sparkling Rosé
entry.summary: An unbranded house-label dealcoholized sparkling rosé sold through US grocery retail, with no verifiable producer or method: the anonymous entry in the category.

entry.title: Almost Zero Ravishing Rosé
entry.summary: Almost Zero Ravishing Rosé is a Total Wine regular in this house. Brand, method, and ABV are not documented beyond the shelf label.

entry.title: Appalina Chardonnay
entry.summary: Appalina is the alcohol-free line of Rheinhessen's Weinkellerei Hechtsheim: lemon, pear and green apple under 0.5%, priced like a house wine.

entry.title: Asahi Dry Zero
entry.summary: Asahi Dry Zero is Japan's flagship non-alcohol beer-style drink: 0.00% ABV, formulated from the ground up rather than dealcoholized, dry and clean.

entry.title: Athletic Brewing Run Wild IPA
entry.summary: America's largest dedicated NA brewery built Run Wild on a proprietary process it doesn't disclose: under 0.5% ABV, 70 calories, Citra and Mosaic over US and German malt.

entry.title: Band of Vintners Freestyle
entry.summary: The 2024 Freestyle NA is late-harvest organic fruit from Sonoma County and Lodi. Band of Vintners' shop does not document how the alcohol left.

entry.title: Be Free Chardonnay
entry.summary: Be Free's Chardonnay: German fruit, under 0.5% ABV, semi-sweet by design — a simple pour that knows what it is.

entry.title: Be Free Rosé
entry.summary: A German de-alcoholised rosé sold at Total Wine for about $10: watermelon and cherry, friendly and light, method undisclosed.

entry.title: Be Free Sauvignon Blanc
entry.summary: Be Free's German Sauvignon Blanc is sold at Total Wine as dealcoholized by a 'special method.' No ABV or technique is published on that page.

entry.title: Be Free White Sparkling
entry.summary: Be Free's sparkling white: 0.5% ABV, 29 kcal per 100 ml, citrus and cream notes — the brand's toast-friendly bottle.

entry.title: Best Day Brewing Kölsch
entry.summary: Best Day Brewing's Kölsch is one of the cleanest expressions in American craft NA: light, crisp, gently toasty, finishing dry and clean at <0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Biagio Cru Rosé All Day
entry.summary: Biagio Cru Rosé All Day is a Total Wine NA rosé bought twice in this house. Process and ABV are unpublished.

entry.title: Clearscape Non-Alcoholic Chardonnay
entry.summary: Clearscape Chardonnay is a 750 ml Australian NA white sold through Total Wine. Melon, white peach, almond — method unpublished.

entry.title: Clearscape Non-Alcoholic Rosé
entry.summary: Clearscape's non-alcoholic rosé is an Australian 750 ml bottle sold at Total Wine. Process details are unpublished.

entry.title: Crodino Non-Alcoholic Spritz
entry.summary: Crodino is a 1965 Italian non-alcoholic bitter that arrived in the US in May 2025: 0.0% ABV, bittersweet and golden, designed to be poured over ice the same way you pour an Aperol Spritz.

entry.title: DC Brau Non-Alcoholic Pale Ale
entry.summary: DC Brau's non-alcoholic pale ale is a Washington, DC brewery product sold at Total Wine and Metro. Method and ABV are not published on a page we can cite.

entry.title: Freixenet 0,0 Sparkling White
entry.summary: Freixenet's alcohol-removed sparkling white, made from Airén grapes in Penedès, the same DO as the brand's Cava. Sub-0.05% ABV, sold nationwide at a Cava-adjacent price point. Removal method unpublished.

entry.title: Freixenet 0,0 Sparkling Rosé
entry.summary: Freixenet's alcohol-removed sparkling rosé is Airén-led, under 0.05% ABV, and 38 g/L residual sugar. The removal method is still unpublished.

entry.title: French Bloom Le Blanc
entry.summary: French Bloom's Le Blanc is a classic-method-dealcoholized French Chardonnay sparkling: organic, 0.0% ABV, blended with organic grape juice and a lemon accent post-removal.

entry.title: Giesen 0% Riesling
entry.summary: Giesen makes full-strength Marlborough Riesling first, removes the alcohol with spinning cone technology, and keeps the lime-and-mandarin varietal core intact.

entry.title: Giesen 0% Rosé
entry.summary: Giesen ferments a full-strength Marlborough and Waipara rosé, then removes the alcohol with spinning cone technology. Less than 0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Giesen 0% Sauvignon Blanc
entry.summary: New Zealand's best-selling alcohol-removed white, built the honest way: full-strength Sauvignon Blanc first, alcohol stripped after via spinning cone.

entry.title: Go Brewing Suspended In A Sunbeam Pils
entry.summary: Go Brewing's Sunbeam Pils is a German-malt-and-hop non-alcoholic pilsner from Naperville, Illinois: under 0.5% ABV, crisp and clean, $14.99 a six-pack.

entry.title: Grad 36°
entry.summary: Grad 36° is 75% dealcoholized red wine with damson, currant, and blackberry juice. Under 0.5% ABV, still, 750 ml.

entry.title: Grolsch 0.0%
entry.summary: Grolsch 0.0% is a Dutch pilsner brewed with barley, two hop varieties and spring water: 0% ABV, full-bodied, with the brewery's signature green-hop character.

entry.title: Guinness 0.0
entry.summary: A St James's Gate stout with the alcohol filtered out cold. Cream, coffee, and that familiar surge — then a slightly sweeter, lighter finish.

entry.title: Halfway Crooks Brevet IPA
entry.summary: Halfway Crooks' non-alcoholic Brevet IPA is a real SKU, logged on Untappd and bought at Metro. The brewery has not published its ABV or method on a product page we can cite.

entry.title: Halfway Crooks Brevet Pils
entry.summary: Atlanta's Halfway Crooks brews the Brevet line under 0.5% ABV; the pilsner is crisp, quietly weird in the best way, and cheap by NA-can standards.

entry.title: Dr. Heidemanns-Bergweiler Riesling
entry.summary: Dr. Heidemanns-Bergweiler is a Mosel estate. This non-alcoholic Riesling arrived via Total Wine Instacart. Method and ABV are unpublished.

entry.title: Heineken 0.0
entry.summary: Heineken brews its traditional beer with A-Yeast, double-brews to protect aromatics, then extracts the ethanol with vacuum distillation columns: 0.0% ABV, 21 kcal per 100 ml.

entry.title: HOP WTR Blood Orange
entry.summary: HOP WTR's Blood Orange is a hopping sparkling water blended with Italian blood orange, adaptogens and vitamins at <0.5% ABV; closest thing to an American NA shandy on a non-fermented base.

entry.title: JP. Chenet So Free Sparkling Rosé
entry.summary: JP. Chenet's So Free Sparkling Rosé is a dealcoholized Bordeaux Pinot Noir rosé: full-strength wine first, alcohol removed after, under 0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Kolonne Null Riesling
entry.summary: Kolonne Null removes alcohol from organic German Riesling by vacuum distillation at about 30°C. The current Riesling is labeled 0.0% vol.

entry.title: Kolonne Null Rosé
entry.summary: Kolonne Null's rosé is traditionally vinified Provence fruit dealcoholized by vacuum distillation in the producer's own Berlin laboratory: 0.0% vol, €10.70 a bottle.

entry.title: Lagunitas Hazy IPNA
entry.summary: Lagunitas' non-alcoholic hazy IPA sits at 0.50% ABV. The brewery is explicit: it does not remove alcohol from finished beer.

entry.title: Lapo's Non-Alcoholic Negroni
entry.summary: Lapo's Non-Alcoholic Negroni is a Florence-born canned NA cocktail: <0.5% ABV, made from Italian ingredients to be built rather than poured straight.

entry.title: Lautus Non-Alcoholic Wine Bundle
entry.summary: Lautus arrived twice as a bundle SKU. The order email does not name the wines inside. No tasting score.

entry.title: Leitz Eins-Zwei-Zero Riesling
entry.summary: A Rheingau Riesling put through vacuum distillation. Citrus, rhubarb, and a dry-seeming finish — with more residual sugar than the word dry implies.

entry.title: Leitz Eins-Zwei-Zero Sparkling Riesling
entry.summary: Johannes Leitz dealcoholizes the Eins-Zwei-Zero family — still and sparkling — by vacuum distillation at about 29°C. The sparkling Riesling is that process with bubbles.

entry.title: Lyre's Amalfi Spritz
entry.summary: Lyre's Amalfi Spritz is an Australian-made non-alcoholic canned spritz inspired by Mediterranean aperitivo culture: bitter orange, rhubarb, and a fine persistent bubble at <0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Lyre's Italian Orange
entry.summary: A built-from-scratch blood-orange aperitif under 0.3% ABV. Useful in a Negroni-shaped drink. Not wine, not a spirit, not dealcoholized.

entry.title: Magic Box Vanish Riesling
entry.summary: Magic Box's Vanish line sources its dealcoholized Riesling from Germany: delicate citrus, mineral and petrol notes at 0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Mingle Sparkling Raspberry Rosé
entry.summary: Mingle's Sparkling Raspberry Rosé is a real-juice sparkling mocktail at 0.00% ABV: crisp raspberry, light bubbles, sold by the can and the case.

entry.title: Mionetto Alcohol-Removed Sparkling Wine
entry.summary: Mionetto 0.0% is a Prosecco-method Venetian sparkling white, fully fermented before the alcohol is extracted: gentle bubbles, off-dry fruit, 0.5% ABV, $16.99 a bottle.

entry.title: Nonny Czech Pilsner
entry.summary: Nonny's Czech Pilsner is a traditional-ingredient NA lager from the Czech Republic: water, barley, hops, yeast, 42 calories a can, real bitterness.

entry.title: Noughty Dealcoholized Rosé
entry.summary: Thomson & Scott's still Noughty Rosé is Western Cape Chenin Blanc with 2% Pinotage, dealcoholized by spinning cone under vacuum. Under 0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Thomson & Scott Noughty Sparkling Chardonnay
entry.summary: Organic La Mancha Chardonnay, dealcoholized, then lightly carbonated. Pale, crisp, and modestly sweet — with a documented alcohol-removal step.

entry.title: Oddbird Blanc de Blancs
entry.summary: A Swedish brand's French-made sparkling Blanc de Blancs, aged 12 months in oak before the alcohol is vacuum-distilled out. Reads closer to Champagne-style than most dealcoholized proseccos.

entry.title: Original Sin Cider (Widow Family)
entry.summary: Original Sin's Widow Family 12-pack is their NA lineup: apple-cider-vinegar and fruit-juice based, monk-fruit sweetened, never alcohol-fermented; four flavors from White Widow blackberry to Dragon's blood.

entry.title: Pierre Zéro Rosé (Bag-in-Box)
entry.summary: Pierre Zéro's Bag-in-Box rosé is three litres of dealcoholized French rosé from Maison Chavin, the range's pioneer since 2010: redcurrant and bilberry fruit, <0.5% ABV.

entry.title: Rondel Zero Cava Rosé
entry.summary: Rondel Zero is a Spanish non-alcoholic sparkling rosé sold at Total Wine. Fine bubbles, red fruit, no cited removal process.

entry.title: Savyll Moscow Mule
entry.summary: Savyll's Moscow Mule is a Total Wine RTD. It is treated as formulated, not dealcoholized, because no source describes alcohol removal.

entry.title: Sober Spirits W 0.0% Whisky
entry.summary: A real dealcoholized Scottish whisky, rebuilt in France: 0.0% ABV, 0% sugar, the closest thing to an honest zero-proof whisky pour.

entry.title: Spiritless Kentucky 74
entry.summary: Louisville's reverse-distilled whiskey alternative. Alcohol is removed from an oak-charged high-proof spirit. It is not dealcoholized Maker's Mark.

entry.title: St. Regis Non-Alcoholic Rosé
entry.summary: A German-made Syrah/Shiraz rosé, vacuum-distilled to remove alcohol, sold nationally at Total Wine for under $13. Producer-confirmed method; taste reception is mixed.

entry.title: St. Agrestis Phony Negroni
entry.summary: St. Agrestis' Phony Negroni is the brand's flagship NA cocktail: 30 organic, non-GMO botanicals, 0.0% ABV, and the closest any formulated NA negroni gets to the bitter-piney Italian original.

entry.title: Torres Serena Sauvignon Blanc
entry.summary: Serena Mode is Central Valley Sauvignon Blanc, fermented then dealcoholized to 0.0% ABV per the 2024 technical sheet.

entry.title: Untitled Art FLVR! NA Mango Dragonfruit Sour
entry.summary: Untitled Art's FLVR! Mango Dragonfruit Sour is a tart, tropical NA fruit sour from Wisconsin: under 0.5% ABV, 90 calories, vivid mango and dragonfruit character.

entry.title: WiesenObst Cider Rosé
entry.summary: Jörg Geiger's WiesenObst Rosé is dealcoholized cider cut with dealcoholized red wine, hops, herbs, and flowers. Under 0.5% ABV, 330 ml cans.

entry.title: Wölffer Spring in a Bottle
entry.summary: Spring in a Bottle is sold at Total Wine as 0.0% ABV alcohol-removed sparkling rosé, organically grown, $20.99. The process is not named.
